evidence: Pinned source: https://github.com/Ryze-AI-Adgent/open-seo-mcp-skills/tree/f587b0a69dc1ed92b65cdb241e4f14985b1031fd. Observed instructions use first-party GSC/GA4/ads data, before/after joins and page inspection. Official semantics checked on 2026-11-13: https://developers.google.com/webmaster-tools/v1/searchanalytics/query says returned rows are bounded/top rows; https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7042828?hl=en defines CTR, topmost aggregate position and canonical attribution; https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/15258820?hl=en explains missing traffic attribution. These references support the metric boundaries, not a claim of tested provider integration.

Extended only the existing SEO workflow; preserved canonical metadata and technical guidance. Used the maintained projection helper for its missing Codex projection. Existing package/install registration is unchanged; generated simple matching canonical/native UI required by the existing Codex surface test. Seven independent artifact-only cases matched held-out decisions for unequal windows, capped/absent rows, AI referrals, ads overlap, a valid aggregate comparison, missing access and query/page grain. These are instruction decisions, not live SEO impact, connector, ad experiment or attribution tests.
reason: Extend the existing SEO owner with a small measurement workflow. Use authorized exports/tools, report observed scope and limitations, and separate clicks/sessions/citations/causal savings. No additional SEO skill, vendor dependency or external mutation is justified.
